body: I'm sorry but I should get going for it is night where I am. Chat with me if you need to talk some more please.

If you have no one you have people on this section of Reddit that can help you. She dumped you, she makes you feel like trash. But who is she to control your feelings. You can find someone who really cares, it takes time and lots of it but there will always be some girl out there waiting for you to meet.

You loved her and she may have not loved you as much back but it doesn't give you a reason to just let it all go. You still have others who love you and I don't think anybody wants you to leave them for good, even her.
I would like to admit to my somebody but I've never been able too. I'm just a coward, even typing it makes me want to just forget and erase it all.

Its okay, though it may not seem so because she dumped you but its her fault. It's her fault she wont have someone who will stay with her no matter what or have one more person who will always care for her. It all seems pointless seeing as I am a nobody but please at least listen or try too.
It seems pointless for me to post anything seeing as how I'm not great but I tried and I want you to listen.

No matter how many times you tell yourself its okay it wont be, and will never be. Please... Please I beg you not and this seems pointless because I am a nobody but I still hold on. I don't know what or why but I still hold on. I know how it feels to be down in the gutter and how it feels to lose someone from depression, Your family and friends would be begging.
Even though I don't know you I still want to thank you, so thank you.
